card.title: I Taught You to Compete
card.instruction: Treat every capable move around you as evidence that your coaching worked. Praise the result while claiming seniority over the method.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely winning serve. My drills finally paid off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You watched me practise. Observation is powerful teaching.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I copied the person who beat you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my defeat provided the lesson. You're welcome.

mechanism: A claims another player's successful serve as the outcome of their own teaching, including defeat as a lesson.
confusable: Unlike ordinary boasting, A must praise B's actual success while annexing the method as mentorship.
comparison: S197-a recasts learning from a rival as A's teaching; S197-b recasts excluding A as graduation.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
